item.title: Huawei Mate XTs Goes Official on Vmall: Tri-Fold Smartphone in 4 Colours, Launching Sept 4
item.description: Huawei is gearing up to launch its next-generation foldable, the Mate XTs, in China next week. Ahead of its official debut on September 4, the company has begun accepting pre-reservations for the device via Vmall. New listings and teasers on Weibo have confirmed the smartphone’s design, key features, and available variants.

item.title: Global Smartphone Market to Grow 1% in 2025 Amid Economic Headwinds
item.description: The global smartphone market is projected to grow by 1% in 2025, reaching 1.24 billion units, according to the latest forecast from IDC’s Worldwide Quarterly Mobile Phone Tracker. This marks a slight improvement from the previous 0.6% growth estimate, though still down from the 2.6% originally projected earlier this year. item.description: In India, petrol and diesel prices are revised every day at 6 a.m. Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) update the rates based on global crude oil prices and the rupee–dollar exchange rate. This ensures that consumers receive the latest fuel price updates every morning.

item.title: From Village Farmer to Honey Millionaire: How Raju Singh Built a ₹1 Crore Business!
item.description: Raju Singh, a resident of Harpur village in Gorakhpur district of Uttar Pradesh, has today become a role model in the beekeeping business. His brand, “High Growth Honey,” has established a strong identity in honey production and sales. From being an ordinary farmer, Raju Singh has transformed himself into a successful agricultural entrepreneur. At present, he owns around 1,000 bee colonies, and his annual turnover has crossed ₹1 crore.
